summary: WF International Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting an unregistered issuance of 1,020,408 ordinary shares to Ironnexus Limited for consulting services, valued at $500,000 based on the 20-day VWAP, and a 10-for-1 share consolidation approved by shareholders. The share issuance was exempt under Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act and subject to an 18-month lock-up. The consolidation, reducing shares from ~11.3M to ~1.1M, was announced via press release. No special-situation event is triggered; this is a routine capital structure adjustment and equity-for-services issuance. There is no acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review to analyze.
